name: r2a exhaustive switch without default
source: type Sh = { k: "a"; r: number } | { k: "b"; w: number; h: number }; function area(s: Sh): number { switch (s.k) { case "a": return s.r * 2; case "b": return s.w * s.h; } } const label = (s: Sh): string => { switch (s.k) { case "a": return "circle"; case "b": return "rect"; } }; function main(): void { console.log(area({ k: "a", r: 3 }), area({ k: "b", w: 2, h: 5 }), label({ k: "b", w: 1, h: 1 })); }
